Earnings Per Share Diluted increased from 2.01 to 2.1 which also signals improved performance. The company seems to have successfully managed its operational expenses and increased sales.

**Ratio Analysis (Approximation using provided data):**

The company demonstrates positive revenue growth, and healthy operating income improvements. While liabilities have risen slightly, the overall financial health appears robust.
